text: The legacy API (`/api/v0`) and the redirect of URLs without version prefix are still online at the time of checking, but will be shut down ([#15](https://github.com/dracor-org/dracor-tech-reports/issues/15)). After that, the API calls in D7.1 and the v0 examples in this section no longer work against dracor.org. Use API v1, see the [current API documentation](https://dracor.org/doc/api).

These additions were released with [API 1.1.0](https://github.com/dracor-org/dracor-api/releases/tag/v1.1.0) on 13 July 2025; the link to the draft release in footnote 37 no longer works. Later releases: see the [dracor-api releases](https://github.com/dracor-org/dracor-api/releases) (current version 1.4.1).

The examples in this section were run against the DTS implementation on staging.dracor.org in spring 2025 (DTS draft 1-alpha). Production (dracor.org, API 1.4.1) still implements this draft, but staging now implements DTS 1.0 (API 1.5.0 release candidate): responses there differ from the outputs shown here, and some identifiers of citable units have changed (e.g. `front/div[2]` is now `front/castList[1]`). The notebook mentioned in footnote 129 as it was at the time of the report: [tag 2026-11-15-baseline](https://github.com/dracor-org/dracor-notebooks/blob/2026-11-15-baseline/dts/dts.ipynb) ([doi:10.5281/zenodo.24237155](https://hdl.handle.net/10.5281/zenodo.24237155)). An updated version of the notebook for DTS 1.0 is available in the DraCor Notebooks: [Distributed Text Services (DTS) in DraCor](https://dracor-org.github.io/dracor-notebooks/dts/dts.html).
The MCP server mentioned here was a prototype at the time of the report. Current version: [dracor-mcp](https://github.com/dracor-org/dracor-mcp) 1.0.0-beta.2 (November 2026).

With the new front end (dracor-frontend 3.0, currently a release candidate on [staging.dracor.org](https://staging.dracor.org/doc/api)), the interactive API documentation at dracor.org/doc/api is rendered with [Scalar](https://scalar.com) instead of Swagger UI (component `ApiDoc` of [dracor-react](https://github.com/dracor-org/dracor-react)). The Swagger UI described here remains available at [swagger.dracor.org](https://swagger.dracor.org); links to single endpoints (`#/public/…`) work there ([#14](https://github.com/dracor-org/dracor-tech-reports/issues/14)).

This describes a proposal. An ontology resolver has not been implemented so far, so example URIs such as https://dracor.org/ontology/play_name do not resolve. The ontology is developed in [dracor-ontology](https://github.com/dracor-org/dracor-ontology).

The path given here is not correct. Since API 1.1.0 the DraCor API stores the data of each play in a collection `/db/dracor/corpora/{corpusname}/{playname}`, here `/db/dracor/corpora/rus/gogol-revizor`, which holds `metrics.xml` next to the TEI and the other derived files; a collection `db/apps/dracor/corpora` does not exist. The layout is described in the System Documentation: [Corpora › In the database](#docs-corpora-database).
